about: Accent and IELTS-answer test set. Each sentence is spoken by every voice under test; automatic checks run first, then people listen blind (see review sheet).

sentences.listen_for: British: no /r/ after vowels; American: /r/ pronounced
sentences.text: The car park is far from the theatre, near the river.

sentences.listen_for: British: 'water' without r; American: flapped t and r
sentences.text: Could I have a glass of water, please? It's better than coffee.

sentences.listen_for: American: 'butter', 'city' with a flap; British: clear t
sentences.text: The city library has a little garden behind the building.

sentences.listen_for: British: long a in 'can't', 'dance', 'path'; American: short a
sentences.text: I can't find the path to the dance class after lunch.

sentences.listen_for: British: rounded o in 'hot', 'stop'; American: open a
sentences.text: It was too hot to stop at the shop, so we got a coffee.
Please don't phone me before I go home at nine.

sentences.listen_for: Australian: FACE and PRICE diphthongs, rising terminal
sentences.text: Today the weather's great, so we might go to the beach later, mate.
My surname is Smythe. That's S-M-Y-T-H-E.
The street is Gillingham Road, G-I-L-L-I-N-G-H-A-M.
You can call me on oh seven nine double three, four five six, one two eight.

sentences.listen_for: Letters and digits of a UK postcode

sentences.text: The course starts on the 23rd of March and ends on the 1st of June.
The ticket costs £12.50, but students pay £8.
The coach leaves at 7:45 and arrives at half past four.
[excited] We won the competition! [serious] But now the real work begins.
[whispering] Let me tell you a secret. [curious] Have you ever wondered why?

sentences.listen_for: Same voice through a long turn
sentences.text: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to the museum. Before we start the tour, I'd like to tell you a little about the building. It was built in 1863 as a railway station, and it became a museum in 1987. Today we'll visit three galleries, and the tour takes about forty minutes.
